review_scope: static: retail instructions and emitted candidate listing

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: 61 bytes, 15 instructions, one block, zero edges; candidate 1/0, score 1.000.

checks.name: cfg_match
checks.rationale: Both decoders and the candidate report 1/0.

checks.name: reset_order
checks.rationale: Three rep stosd clears in retail's order (0x00A950A0 0x1040 bytes, 0x00A94E80 0x208, 0x00A94A80 0x400) then the two constant stores, transcribed in that order.

checks.name: stosd_conversion
checks.rationale: Retail's counts are dwords (0x410, 0x82, 0x100); the transcription clears the byte equivalents 0x1040, 0x208 and 0x400, which is the same memory.

checks.name: constants
checks.rationale: Writes 8 into 0x00942304 and 0xFFFFFFFF into 0x00A94A64, matching the two immediate stores.

checks.name: storage
checks.rationale: All four targets are declared extern and owned elsewhere; 0x00942304 had no owner, so this file defines it. No region overlaps another: the 0x1040 clear covers the eight 0x208 slots, 0x00A94E80 ends where 0x00A950A0 begins, and the 0x400 clear matches 128 records at 8 bytes.

limitations: What 0x00942304 counts is not established; only that this reset stores 8 into it. The value it held before the reset is unobserved.
The clears do not bounds-check anything because they are fixed extents; the extents come from the rep counts and were converted to bytes.
